forecast: runtime-estimate.json; hybrid current HiFi2 panel + frozen original full-diagnostic projections, then wide explicit BF16/HiFi4 multipliers. Planning proxy only; not measured candidate performance or memory fit.

execution.gate: No admission is present. If separately admitted, driver waits for P1 and X terminal success, validates P1 forecast hit or root miss acceptance, verifies no HF process and zero device owners, checks STOP_BEFORE_LAUNCH and duplicate-launch guard, then runs exactly one fixed108 command bounded by timeout7200.
execution.serial_gate: After separate root admission only: verify complete source inventory and actual P1/X admission/proposal/driver bytes; require P1 and X terminal zero, all per-mode forecasts hit or root-accepted misses, exact X command pins, STOP absent, no active HF process and device owners zero, duplicate-launch guard, output directory empty, then one bounded7200 command.

P1.forecast_gate: P1 measured elapsed must be within its frozen launch forecast range or root must author forecast-miss-accepted.json bound to exact completion SHA, elapsed seconds, forecast range, and P1 admission SHA.

X.served_full_forecast_gate: Each X mode elapsed must lie inside its own frozen forecast.json modes[mode].range_s; otherwise require root-authored forecast-miss-accepted-{mode}.json binding exact completion SHA, measured seconds, range, and X admission SHA.
